title: CanDoItAll Agent Chat UI Reuse Refactor - Phase 1
nextPhaseBlockedUntil: explicit user confirmation that Agent Chats behave exactly as before

subbundles.title: Baseline, architecture inventory, and UI parity contract
subbundles.objective: Freeze the real branch baseline, build scoped architecture evidence, inventory all agent-chat consumers, and capture the current rendered behavior before production refactoring begins.

subbundles.title: Neutral Conversation Components boundary
subbundles.objective: Create the app-owned, backend-neutral Razor boundary, its presentation contracts, isolated tests, project references, and source/dependency guards without migrating existing production consumers yet.

subbundles.title: Participant cards, compact lists, and picker extraction
subbundles.objective: Extract reusable participant presentation surfaces while keeping agent ordering, favorites, team semantics, actions, copy, and test selectors behaviorally unchanged through compatibility adapters.

subbundles.title: Conversation thread rail and history extraction
subbundles.objective: Extract the reusable thread list, search, empty/loading states, item presentation, and bounded history dialog while leaving all agent session orchestration and approval semantics in the agent adapter.

subbundles.title: Conversation workspace, transcript, and composer extraction
subbundles.objective: Extract safe markdown, message/transcript presentation, composer chrome, and extension slots while retaining execution, approval, voice, attachment, prompt-gallery, and backend behavior in the legacy agent facade.

subbundles.title: Definition settings and editor-surface extraction
subbundles.objective: Extract reusable editor shell, identity/avatar/instructions fields, provider/model selection presentation, and optional advanced-setting slots without moving agent-only runtime policy or binding to Simple Chat domain types.

subbundles.title: Floating catalog and lifecycle-settings seams
subbundles.objective: Extract floating-window presentation, catalog/list composition, and generic active-chat lifecycle fields while keeping the current host agent-only and preserving context, handle, retention, and preparation behavior.

subbundles.title: Agent consumer migration and architecture closure
subbundles.objective: Migrate every existing agent consumer through the neutral presentation boundary, remove superseded duplication, prove dependency direction, and close architecture review without activating Simple Chats.

subbundles.title: Focused regression proof and user handoff
subbundles.objective: Run the final affected-scope and browser proof once, prepare the manual agent-chat regression checklist, and stop in an explicit awaiting-user-verification state.

checkpoints.title: Baseline and parity contract accepted
checkpoints.gate: Exact branch baseline, healthy scoped CodeAnalytics evidence, complete consumer inventory, and representative normal/open-overlay baseline proof exist before source edits.

checkpoints.title: Neutral boundary accepted
checkpoints.gate: The neutral project or approved fallback compiles, has isolated tests, has no forbidden dependencies, introduces no cycle, and existing production consumers remain behaviorally untouched.

checkpoints.title: Core listing/thread/workspace extraction accepted
checkpoints.gate: Participant, thread, transcript, composer, and markdown behavior is testable through neutral owners; legacy agent facades retain execution/approval/voice/attachment behavior and pass affected proof.

checkpoints.title: Settings and floating seams accepted
checkpoints.gate: Reusable editor and floating presentation seams exist without mixed-source UI, Simple Chat references, or changed agent lifecycle semantics.

checkpoints.title: Architecture and consumer migration closure
checkpoints.gate: All listed consumers compile through the intended boundary, duplicate presentation paths are removed, dependency/source guards pass, and the architecture review finds no cycle, facade-only extraction, service location, or partial-class growth.

checkpoints.title: Focused proof complete; user regression pending
checkpoints.gate: Affected tests and focused browser proof pass, any broad gate was triggered and run at most once, manual checklist is ready, and durable status is awaiting-user-agent-chat-regression.
